description: Search the San Francisco Open Data open data catalogue (Socrata) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "park": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: San Francisco Open Data. License: PDDL 1.0 (Public Domain Dedication and License). Keyword-sensitive catalogue — concrete nouns (park, police, building) match better than broad topics.

query.description: Search term for this source (see the tool description for what it expects).
